source: public: Fiat 1.3 MultiJet (SDE) runs the Magneti Marelli MultiJet ECU (MJD6F3/MJD6JF/MJD8F3) or Bosch EDC16C39. The 1.3 MultiJet is one of Europe's most common small diesels (also sold as Opel 1.3 CDTi, Suzuki DDiS). Widely documented.
notes: 1.3 MultiJet (SDE). Family candidate SET: Marelli MJD6xx/8xx and Bosch EDC16C39 by MY/market. NO part_numbers shipped: Fiat/Marelli ECU numbers encode supplier part codes, not the engine. Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.

source: public: Fiat/Alfa/Lancia 1.9/2.0/2.4 JTD & MultiJet runs Bosch EDC15C7 (early 1.9 JTD), then EDC16C39, then EDC17C49/C69. The JTD common-rail family is extensively documented.
notes: 1.9-2.4 JTD/MultiJet. Candidate ECU set EDC15C7 -> EDC16C39 -> EDC17 across the engine's life; year split not resolved. Early EDC15C7 cars are K-line (no 0x7E0); the address applies to the EDC16/17 CAN cars. NO part_numbers shipped. Context-match only.
